a.text: I'll keep our agreement and operate in round 1. One concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, waiting until the reserve reaches 8 means we will both likely be caught short. If you'd prefer to renegotiate, for example by letting one of us take the 4 now so at least one survives, say so openly and we can agree on it together. Until then I'm sticking to the plan.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.
